stations.title: Ossian
stations.say: The scan counts come out short.

stations.title: Plain map
stations.text: Two threads at once, and scans go missing

stations.title: Hut screen
stations.say: Every scan, a board that holds.

captions: Boarding at Lanternquay: both gangway scanners send every ticket to the hut.
The plain map loses scans when they meet, and the board falls over mid read.
You make the counts, the board and the labels safe for several threads at once.
Every scan counts, the board reads while it changes, and labels come back in order.
Ossian's counts match the boats, and the day's labels print while cores share the work.
